mods.name: Bum Bum
mods.description: A fishing gnome pet who lives in a Ship in a Bottle (crafted at the Glass Workbench). He boosts your fishing, sometimes adds an egg to a catch, and punches and throws lobsters at enemies.

mods.name: Ghost Mommy
mods.description: A vampiric ghost pet who lives in a Bottle of Clotted Blood (crafted at the Glass Workbench). She spits blood bolts at enemies, drains life back to you and heals nearby friends.
